Nora Blake: Quick reminder — all-hands today 11:00am PT. Agenda: (1) brief exec state + runway snapshot; (2) Hosted usage quota policy: why and timeline; (3) Dedicated capacity GA callouts; (4) Console cost/observability highlight; (5) lightning Q&A. Drop one-line questions here or use the form: https://forms.redwood-inference/c/allhands-spotlight

Diego Park: I'll cover the quota rationale and migration path. Short note: this is to reduce noisy overages and give customers clearer cost controls.

Samir Verma: Ops question — when quota enforcement triggers, do we send an automated escalation to customer success?

Diego Park: Yes — automated email + CS alert for tiered customers. For pilot customers we'll do manual outreach first.

Ivy (Legal): Flag: EU/UK regulated customers need explicit notice windows. Will review customer-facing language before send.

ops-bot: Reminder: meeting starts in 10 minutes — join at https://meet.redwood-inference/allhands-3581234567

--- meeting happened ---

Nora Blake: Thanks for joining. Recording: https://redwood-inference.company/recordings/allhands-3581234567. Slides: https://redwood-inference.company/slides/allhands-3581234567.pdf

Diego Park: Key bullets: pilot with three partners, opt-in for first 30 days, then soft-enforce with 30-day notice for hosted customers. Dedicated customers unaffected. Migration guide + API flags will be published by Friday.

Samir Verma: Ops actionables: 1) add quota-throttle alerts (2025-04-10); 2) create an emergency rollback flag; 3) schedule a 2-hour canary window with eng-sre this week.

Ivy (Legal): I'll review the messaging by Thursday and note any regional modifications.

Nora Blake: Company takeaways: keep latency & reliability top priority, accelerate Private deployment sales for regulated verticals, and watch unit economics as we roll out quotas. Hiring ask recap in the slides.

Diego Park: ACTIONS: Diego publish migration guide (Fri); Samir setup alerts + canary (this week); Ivy sign off on messaging (Thu); Nora share exec summary + hiring ask (Mon).

Samir Verma: follow-up: canary slot requested in eng-sre calendar.

Diego Park: If you need a dedicated follow-up reply with "follow-up: <topic>" and I'll assign. Closing thread — will post playbook link in #product when live. :rocket:
